## About
Virgo Auto Body is a collision repair shop on Springdale Road in Cherry Hill, and a New Jersey Manufacturers Premier Car Care Shop. We work on all makes and models, from a small dent to frame straightening.
Dan and the crew keep you in the loop while your car is here. One reviewer wrote that Dan and Terry did their best to keep the cost of parts down while still using quality parts. Another brought their car to us after a dealership quote and we found a used door and fender instead.
Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 134 Google reviews. Stop by any weekday and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Free Computerized Estimates: Bring your car in and we'll write up a computerized estimate at no charge. No appointment necessary.
- Expert Body Repair: Collision and body work on all makes and models.
- Computerized / Laser Frame and Uni-body Repair and Straightening: Frame and uni-body repair and straightening using computerized laser equipment.
- Expert Color Matching: Paint matched to your car, done in our own paint booth.
- Paintless Dent Repair: Dents taken out without repainting. Listed as a monthly special. (starting at $125)
- Economical Lease Return Repairs: Get your leased car ready to turn in without overspending.
- Windshield & Glass Replacement: Replacement windshields and auto glass.
- Windshield Stone chip Repair: Stone chips in the windshield repaired.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: No appointment necessary. Just stop by during business hours.

Q: Do I get to choose who repairs my car?
A: Yes. It is your right to choose the shop that will repair your vehicle. Tell them you would like it repaired at Virgo and we will handle your claim.

Q: Can I get a rental car while mine is being repaired?
A: Yes, rentals are available through Enterprise Rental Car.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: We work on all makes and models.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday thru Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
